policy: 仅使用论文、官方基准或作者公开数据集提取字段术语；网页内容不直接改写标准字典，须经等价性审核后进入训练。

sources.title: Multisource Heterogeneous Data Fusion-Based Process Monitoring of the Reheating Furnace in Steel Production
sources.evidence: 论文变量表覆盖炉温、各炉段煤气流量及炉膛/烟气压力等测点。

sources.title: Multi-Mode Model Predictive Control Approach for Steel Billets Reheating Furnaces
sources.evidence: 论文描述各炉区空气/燃料流量、炉温设定和钢坯再热温度轨迹。

sources.title: HSSED: An open-source high-simulation scenario electro-hydraulic distillation dataset
sources.evidence: 公开数据集含液位、流量、温度、压力和纯度等39个精馏测量变量。

sources.title: HSSED author dataset repository
sources.evidence: 论文作者公开的处理后数据与使用脚本，用于核对字段族和数据形态。

sources.title: Deep Learning Model for Measuring Oxygen Content of Boiler Flue Gas
sources.evidence: 论文列出机组负荷、燃料量、一次/二次风、给水、主汽、炉膛负压及烟气含氧量等变量。

sources.title: HAI HIL-based Augmented ICS Security Dataset
sources.evidence: 公开工业控制数据包含Emerson Ovation DCS锅炉过程及连续SCADA标签。

sources.title: Water Level Control in the Thermal Power Plant Steam Separator Based on New PID Tuning Method
sources.evidence: 实际火电机组SCADA子系统明确使用steam drum water level、feedwater flow等测量量。

sources.title: Numerical Optimization of Burner Deflection Angle at Half Load for a 660 MW Tangentially Fired Boiler
sources.evidence: 锅炉热力数据表分别列出primary air flow、secondary air flow和main steam outlet pressure。

sources.title: Challenge Validation: Cement Rotary Kiln Process Study
sources.evidence: 实际水泥窑研究使用多位置温度、还原煤投加、NOx及煅烧温度等过程变量。

sources.title: Data-driven modelling of the rotary kiln process at an industrial cement plant
sources.evidence: 工业水泥厂预热器和回转窑小时数据及关键过程参数。

sources.title: Advanced Process Control for Clinker Rotary Kiln and Grate Cooler
sources.evidence: 工业水泥过程明确描述kiln exit clinker temperature和熟料篦冷机过程测量。

sources.title: Benchmark Simulation Model No. 1 (BSM1) General Description
sources.evidence: IWA基准定义进出水流量、COD、氨氮、溶解氧、污泥回流及氧传递系数等变量。

sources.title: IWA Modelling and Integrated Assessment Benchmarking
sources.evidence: 官方基准说明以KLa控制溶解氧、以内回流控制硝酸盐的控制结构。

sources.title: DAMADICS Lublin Sugar Factory data description
sources.evidence: 项目方说明书给出糖厂锅炉给水、汽包水位、蒸汽流量、压力和温度等真实DCS标签、单位与范围。
